richMathematicalTask: Original IM K5 2021 Grade5 U07:L03 extends the coordinate grid to points sharing one coordinate and to points lying ON the horizontal/vertical axes where one coordinate equals zero. Numeric point location is assessed along with actual student plotting and explanation.
Warm-up Notice and Wonder Points with Zero includes original source picture; students explain why one coordinate being0 does NOT mean an undefined point, it means one axis of the coordinate plane.

Activity1 What's the Point printed Partner A: A(5,1),B(5,2),C(5,3),D(5,4), which are vertically aligned at x5, plus(5,0) on horizontal axis. Partner B: A(4,3),B(5,3),C(6,3),D(7,3), horizontally aligned at y3, plus(0,3) on vertical axis. These actual source positions are recorded precisely.

Activity2 Plotting Points Without a Grid has a source point shown on an axes-only figure whose exact numeric coordinates cannot be certified from text alone; asks students to plot points and determine whether (1,0) and(0,1) can be placed ACCURATELY. Scale must be justified from given visual reference; do not assert a picture shows a unique tick spacing unless verified.

Selected exact Practice validates printed coordinate labels and axes only, not the freehand graphs and teacher discussion. Previous correct invented diagram examples remain optional Edulytiks extensions and original gated source Cool-down is separately unverified.
